panels.title: Forward
panels.description: Probe: a real Xray client on the relay fetches a test page as the forward group, every minute.

panels.title: Direct
panels.description: Probe as the direct group (exits in Russia).

panels.title: Cloudflare
panels.description: Relay health check through Cloudflare, the main path (UP if either of the zone's two addresses works).

panels.title: Fallback
panels.description: CloudFront WebSocket fallback; takes over if Cloudflare fails.

panels.title: Split
panels.description: CloudFront split: YouTube download legs via CloudFront (uploads via Cloudflare).

panels.title: Data age
panels.description: Seconds since the relay's metrics last arrived at the exit through the tunnel.

panels.title: Speed
panels.description: Probe download speed: 10 MB through forward, every 15 minutes, transfer phase only (connection setup excluded; see the probe row for both).

panels.title: Alerts
panels.description: Alerts firing now (vmalert). Details in the table at the bottom.

panels.title: Paths (health checks from the relay, every minute)
Path health
panels.description: exit-cdn = Cloudflare, exit-cfws = CloudFront WebSocket fallback, yt-split-* = CloudFront download legs, mon-* = the monitoring push paths.

panels.title: Health check response time
panels.description: Every Cloudflare outbound has its own connections. A gap between fastest and slowest means single connections are stalling while others work.

panels.title: Probe (a real client through the relay)
Download speed (forward, every 15 min)
panels.description: 10 MB through forward. The file is short, so connection setup (~0.3 s) weighs heavily on the setup-included figure.

panels.title: TCP: relay → Cloudflare, exit ← CDNs (every 30 s)
Stuck connections
panels.description: cloudflare-1/2: the relay's connections to each of the zone's addresses. from-cdns: the exit's connections from Cloudflare and CloudFront. Stuck = sent data unacknowledged for 2+ s.

panels.title: Loss signals per minute
panels.description: Retransmits = loss on the way out; out of order in = loss on the way in. Loss on the relay's side and clean exit = the problem is between the relay and Cloudflare.

panels.title: Download to users, by path
panels.description: Bytes per second per outbound group on the relay (5-minute average).

panels.title: Upload from users, by path
panels.description: Bytes per second per outbound group on the relay (5-minute average).

panels.title: Disconnects per hour, by how they ended
panels.description: A disconnect = a client address with no connection for 10 s. client_closed: VPN off / app stopped. vanished: network gone (~2 min to detect). reset_active: app killed during traffic. stalled: path broke during traffic. Lab-checked on a Linux client only; see PHASE1.md.

panels.title: Clients connected
panels.description: Distinct client addresses with an open connection right now (probe excluded).

panels.title: Let's Encrypt cert
panels.description: Days until the origin certificate CloudFront checks expires (renewed daily).

panels.title: CDN ranges age
panels.description: Days since the exit firewall's CDN address list was refreshed (update-ranges.sh).

panels.title: Monitoring push path
panels.description: At least one path for the relay's metrics is up.
